title: Tensoring a quasi-coherent module by an invertible module
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then for every integer $n$, the tensor product $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$ (with negative powers defined using the dual invertible module) is quasi-coherent.
